Exhaustive q=3,5 target enumeration matches all seven values, although finite tests do not prove the uniform odd-prime-power theorem.

value.rationale: The first full noncommutative matrix algebra has a natural bilinear Jordan word. Knowing a single homogeneous anti-commuting count does not determine how its q^8 ordered pairs split among q^4 prescribed values. The complete seven-stratum fiber census exposes dependence on invariant rational eigenlines and has natural meaning for word-map distributions, distinct from routine fixed-matrix Sylvester solvability.
